title: Offshore Cargo Supervisor
description:
We are looking for an Offshore Cargo Supervisor for one of our clients in O&G, in an offshore position (14 X 14).

This is a TEMPORARY POSITION, for a 6 ~ 9 months (renewable) project.

Offshore Cargo Supervisor: What will your responsibilities and missions be?

Responsible for supervising, monitoring, and participating in all marine-related activities, such as offloading operations, transshipment with support vessels, cargo handling and cleaning, ballasting operations, tank washing (COW), equipment maintenance, diving operations, and pull-in/pull-out operations. All these activities must be carried out with a focus on safety and in compliance with internal and external procedures and regulations, always in support of the Marine Superintendent and under his authority. He is also jointly responsible for ensuring the readiness and availability of the offshore facility's rescue equipment.

What Profile and Skills are Required for this Cargo Supervisor Position?

  • Nationality: Brazilian Only
  • Local of work: Offshore – onboard FPSOs (boarding points: Jacarepaguá, Macaé, Farol de São Tomé, Cabo Frio, Maricá)
  • English: Intermediate to Advanced

Graduation/Certificate:

  • Minimum: Marine or technical background — e.g., Marinheiro de Convés, CB, Mestre de Cabotagem or equivalent maritime certification.
  • Required Certifications (valid at embark): CBSP, CACI, CESS, MCIA, NR-33 (Confined Space), NR-35 (Work at Heights), H2S Awareness, Benzeno Awareness, GASD, ECOW (modules 1 to 4)
  • Search parameters: COW AND Ballast Operations AND Diving Support AND Lifesaving Equipment AND Offshore Cargo Handling

Experience:

  • Proven experience in offshore cargo operations, marine logistics, ballast management, and tank cleaning procedures
  • Experience coordinating diving support and marine safety inspections
  • Availability for temporary offshore rotation (14x14)

Are you interested in this position? Send us your application!

By joining our team, you will be expected to follow HSE procedures and best practices while contributing to the continuous improvement of our processes.

With an international presence — including subsidiaries in Latin America, Africa, and Asia — we collaborate with major industry players and offer exciting career growth opportunities in France and worldwide.

At EP2C Energy , we value our employees’ expertise and are committed to their professional and personal development.

Joining EP2C Energy means becoming part of a dynamic team and an ambitious mission!

title: Section Manager
description:

Are you a hands-on professional with a passion for precision and performance? Join us in delivering high-quality MEP systems for landmark projects in the UAE.

  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEMCO provides integrated MEP and facilities services that power some of the region’s most ambitious developments. From electrical systems to long-term maintenance, we focus on technical reliability and sustainable performance - supported by an inclusive and skilled team with a passion for engineering excellence.

Why Join Us?

As a Section Manager, you’ll play a vital role in the successful execution of MEP works across complex data center projects. You’ll lead field productivity, manage change effectively, and ensure technical excellence in every phase.

At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us to deliver Project Planning and Controls initiatives that directly shape our business success, from sourcing candidates to enhancing candidate experiences.

About Your Team

You’ll report directly to the Construction Manager, with indirect reporting to the Project Manager, and will lead a team of Site Engineers and Foremen. The section management team ensures quality, safety, productivity, and coordination across MEP disciplines, collaborating closely with planning, QA/QC, procurement, and subcontractors to ensure seamless execution across project zones and disciplines.

Your Role

As a Section Manager, you will:

  • Issue daily/weekly installation plans and report progress.
  • Enforce method statements, risk assessments, and DSTI schedules.
  • Track material deliveries in coordination with Project Engineers.
  • Manage change and drawing/spec distribution.
  • Monitor tools, consumables, KPIs, and labour productivity.
  • Ensure HSE and QA/QC compliance at all times.
  • Work week: Monday to Saturday (standard for project-based roles in the region)

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years’ experience in MEP construction or infrastructure
  • Strong knowledge of installation sequencing, QA/QC, and HSE
  • Site leadership and technical documentation experience
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills

What We Offer

  • Total package of salary, UAE Employment Visa, Medical Insurance & Annual ticket allowance.
  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE's most iconic projects.
  • A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to Lead?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEMCO and shape the future of infrastructure delivery in the UAE.

Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.

title: Principal Pipeline Drafter 25002281
description:
Company Overview:

People power our future. That is why advancing a dynamic, inclusive environment, where everyone grows and thrives is critically important to us. Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing offshore platforms hundreds of miles from shore, and using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure.

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries. Here, what you do matters.

Job Overview:

The Principal Pipeline Drafter directly impacts the effectiveness of their team and related team. They exchange ideas and information relating to Pipeline Drafting effectively. The Principal Pipeline Drafter may work autonomously within established Pipeline Drafting procedures and practices. They act as a lead, coordinating the work of others. The Principal Pipeline Drafter proposes improvements to processes and methods within the Pipeline Drafting discipline.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with project teams to develop and refine detailed piping system designs, ensuring compliance with applicable codes, standards, and project specifications
  • Prepare accurate and comprehensive 2D and 3D pipeline drawings, layouts, and schematics using computer-aided design and drafting (CADD) software
  • Review and interpret project drawings, specifications, and engineering deliverables to accurately capture project requirements and constraints
  • Coordinate with other disciplines such as process, mechanical, and structural engineering to integrate pipeline designs seamlessly into the overall project layout
  • Provide technical support and guidance to junior draftsmen to ensure high-quality and timely deliverables
  • Conduct interdisciplinary clash detection reviews to identify and mitigate clashes or conflicts among various piping systems, equipment, and structures
  • Assist in the preparation of material take-offs, bills of quantity (BOQ), and requisitions to support procurement activities
  • Continuously improve pipeline design processes and standards, staying updated with the latest industry practices, advancements, and technological tools
  • Collaboratively work with project managers and engineers to effectively communicate design progress, and challenges, and ensure timely completion of deliverables
  • Participate in design reviews, constructability assessments, and HAZOP studies to provide valuable insights and contributions to the project team
  • Implement Prefabrication, Erection methods, and DC reports information into shop drawing
  • Implement design change in the shop drawing based on approved SQ, TQ, SI and ARN
  • Identify non-original scope using Change Management System

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • High School diploma or higher with a focus in Mechanical Engineering, Pipeline Engineering, or related field
  • Minimum of 8 years of Pipeline Drafter experience in the Oil & Gas Construction Industry, with a focus on pipelines, and demonstrates a strong understanding of pipeline design principles and practices.
  • Proficiency in using CAD software, such as AutoCAD, Navisworks, PDS, PDMS, Bently Microstation, or similar tools, for creating pipeline/piping designs and drawings
  • Familiarity with different pipeline materials, fittings, and supports, and their respective installation methods and constraints
  • Strong understanding of pipeline/piping design concepts, including isometric, orthographic, and schematic drawings
  • Deep knowledge of industry-specific codes and standards like ASME B31.3, ASME B31.4, API 570, API 1104 and ASME Sections VIII & IX
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on accuracy and quality in drawing creation and review processes
  • Strong understanding of interdisciplinary coordination and interface management among various engineering disciplines
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders
  • Flexible and adaptable mindset to thrive in a dynamic and challenging work environment

title: Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Pleno | DCP
description:
Descrição da vaga

Nossas +1600 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.

A área de Planejamento em Prevenção de Perdas atua como o cérebro estratégico da operação, conectando análises financeiras, orçamentárias e contratuais à execução prática das ações de mitigação de perdas em toda a cadeia operacional. Seu papel é garantir o uso eficiente dos recursos destinados à Prevenção de Perdas, por meio do controle rigoroso de orçamento (budget), acompanhamento de CAPEX/OPEX, e gestão de contratos com fornecedores de tecnologia, segurança, auditoria e serviços correlatos.

Além disso, a área é responsável pelo provisionamento e reversão contábil de perdas, garantindo aderência às políticas internas e compliance com normas financeiras. A interlocução com áreas como Controladoria, Compras, Jurídico, Financeiro e Operações é constante, exigindo perfil analítico, organizado e com forte senso de responsabilidade sobre prazos e entregas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Garantir que os investimentos e despesas da área estejam aderentes ao budget anual, monitorando variações, evitando estouros e propondo realocações estratégicas quando necessário.
  • Assegurar o correto acompanhamento de vigência contratual, SLA, reajustes, aditivos e pagamentos de notas fiscais, evitando atrasos, glosas ou passivos.
  • Atuar como elo entre Prevenção de Perdas e áreas como Financeiro, Controladoria e Jurídico, traduzindo necessidades operacionais em ações financeiras/compliance e vice-versa.
  • Realizar estimativas confiáveis de perdas e investimentos, com metodologia clara para provisionamento e reversões, fundamentando tomadas de decisão do comitê executivo.
  • Equilibrar investimentos de capital (ex: instalação de novas tecnologias) e despesas operacionais (ex: manutenção de sistemas de CFTV) de forma eficiente e transparente.
  • Buscar constantemente formas de reduzir retrabalho, integrar sistemas (ERP, BI, etc.) e melhorar a previsibilidade e rastreabilidade de informações e custos.
  • Contribuir para a construção de um plano de perdas sustentável, que una a inteligência financeira ao propósito de proteger o negócio de riscos e desperdícios.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Domínio em gestão orçamentária e financeira.
  • Conhecimento em gestão contratual e compliance.
  • Habilidade em análise de perdas e provisionamento.
  • Conhecimento em investimentos de capital e despesas operacionais.
  • Vivência com sistemas integrados, como: ERP (SAP, Oracle, Totvs, etc.), BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, etc.)
  • Análise estratégica e mindset de negócios.
  • Pacote Office avançado.

OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos emails e no spam.

Informações adicionais

Nossos benefícios:

Somos adeptos ao regime e benefícios CLT, oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de saúde Bradesco;
  • Plano odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro

QUEM SOMOS

Quem Somos:

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito:

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas , de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos .

Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

title: General Foreman
description:
General Foreman - Civil | UAE

Are you a hands-on construction leader with deep structural experience and a drive for delivering high-quality work on time, every time?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a General Foreman , you’ll lead multiple structural work zones, from formwork and concrete to steel and blockwork. You’ll manage a team of Senior Foremen, ensuring all structural activities are planned, resourced, executed, and handed over to the highest technical and safety standards. Your role is critical to coordinating construction efforts, maintaining productivity, and upholding ALEC’s commitment to quality and environmental compliance.

About Your Team

You’ll report to the Section Manager and lead teams of Senior Foremen, Foremen, and labour across various structural disciplines. You’ll work closely with planning, procurement, safety, and QA/QC teams to ensure seamless execution across all phases of work.

Your Role

As a General Foreman, you will:

  • Lead and support Foremen in managing labour and tradesmen across all structural work fronts.
  • Interpret structural drawings and ensure accurate site setup and execution.
  • Plan resources effectively and manage site access, logistics, and emergency readiness.
  • Ensure the timely procurement and correct usage of construction materials and plant.
  • Enforce ALEC’s safety policies, ensuring work is carried out using the proper PPE and safety procedures.
  • Manage heavy equipment and ensure only qualified operators handle machinery.
  • Coordinate across structural teams including carpentry, steel, rebar, blockwork, and concrete.
  • Drive productivity initiatives, ensuring teams work at optimal efficiency.
  • Lead by example, coach site teams, and identify upskilling needs for unskilled labour.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO standards, carry out quality audits, and implement corrective actions.
  • Support environmental management before, during, and after construction phases.
  • Oversee the structural handover process with complete documentation and quality verification.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience : 10+ years in construction with at least 2 years as a Senior Foreman, specifically in structural works.
  • Certifications : First Aider qualification is required.
  • Technical Knowledge : Strong understanding of structural works including formwork, blockwork, rebar, and carpentry.
  • Leadership : Proven ability to manage large, multi-disciplinary site teams and interface with support functions.
  • Planning & Coordination : Skilled in short-term planning, resource control, and progress tracking.
  • Communication : Effective communicator who builds trust across teams and levels.
  • Safety & Quality : Committed to site safety and consistent delivery to quality standards.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to plan the path to project success?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.

Apply today and be part of something excellent!

Kindly upload your CV in English.

Who We are?

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Foreman, you’ll take frontline responsibility for executing daily site activities safely, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards. You’ll lead your team on the ground, translating technical drawings into action and ensuring work progresses according to project plans.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building iconic structures, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner on some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value reliability, innovation, and our people. Join us to lead high-performing site teams that drive delivery excellence.

About Your Team

You’ll report to the Senior Foreman and work closely with engineers, supervisors, subcontractors, and supporting departments including QA/QC and planning. You’ll lead a small team of operatives and coordinate resources to maintain daily momentum and deliver consistent progress.

Your Role

As a Foreman, you will:

  • Lead daily site activities, ensuring works are delivered safely, on time, and to the required quality.
  • Coordinate labour, materials, and equipment to optimise workflow and minimise downtime.
  • Enforce ALEC safety protocols and foster a culture of compliance and awareness.
  • Read and interpret drawings to ensure correct execution and alignment with design intent.
  • Monitor progress and take corrective action to overcome site-level challenges.
  • Maintain accurate records of progress and workforce deployment.
  • Support and motivate your team, resolve on-site issues, and escalate where required.
  • Contribute to improvements in efficiency, cost control, and construction methods.
  • This is a full-time role following a Monday to Saturday work week typical of site-based positions in our industry.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience : 5+ years in a Foreman or similar site-based supervisory role within the GCC.
  • Technical Knowledge : Practical understanding of construction activities, materials, and sequencing.
  • Leadership : Proven ability to guide and manage small site teams effectively.
  • Communication : Clear verbal and written communication with team members and engineers.
  • Skills : Skilled in site planning, resource coordination, and drawing interpretation.
  • Safety-First Mindset : Strong awareness of HSE principles and site compliance.

title: Draughtsman - Civil
description:
Civil Draughtsman - Design | UAE

Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Civil Draughtsman , you will be responsible for creating the technical drawings and plans that serve as the foundation for our construction projects. You will transform architectural and engineering concepts into accurate, detailed drawings that guide project teams through every phase of construction. Your work will ensure that our designs are clearly communicated, compliant with regulations, and efficiently executed on site.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

Your Role

  • Prepare detailed architectural and structural drawings for building construction projects.
  • Develop general arrangement (GA) drawings, foundation plans, sections, elevations, and detail drawings.
  • Support the design team by translating conceptual sketches and technical data into accurate CAD drawings.
  • Collaborate on the development of structural layouts, floor plans, and utility networks.
  • Update and revise designs based on feedback from engineers, architects, or site observations.
  • Ensure all drawings comply with local building codes, design standards, and project specifications.
  • Maintain organized and version-controlled drawing files within the design department.
  • Coordinate with other disciplines (electrical, mechanical) to ensure design integration and conflict resolution.

What We’re Looking For

  • Familiarity with Revit, Civil 3D, or other BIM software is advantageous.
  • Understanding of construction methods, site logistics, and temporary works.
  • Experience with local authority drawing submissions and approval processes.
  • Bachelor's in Civil Engineering / Drafting Technology or equivalent.
  • Proven experience as a draughtsman in the building construction or architectural design industry.
  • High proficiency in AutoCAD; Revit, Civil 3D, or other BIM tools are a strong advantage.
  • Good understanding of civil and structural design principles and building systems.
  • Strong ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple design tasks simultaneously.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Garantindo credibilidade para com nossos clientes internos e externos.

Descrição detalhada das atividades:

1. Garantir informações de fontes confiáveis, que sejam relevantes para formação do Planejamento Tributário para tomada de decisões, por meio de treinamentos, participações em Workshop, palestras, cursos de Especialização, acessar bibliografia, textos, internet com o objetivo de atualizar os conhecimentos a respeito de determinado assunto.

2. Aconselhar área de compras com informações pertinentes, de modo a usar os benefícios fiscais na realização das compras junto aos fornecedores, garantindo redução tributária. Informar ao comprador, de forma clara e transparente, quais são os benefícios fiscais e de como usá-los, para correta utilização dos IVA(s) evitando o retrabalho;

3. Assegurar a entrega das obrigações acessórias dentro dos prazos estabelecidos, garantindo a execução dos processos para aquela demanda apresentada, por meio de programas específicos desenvolvidos junto a consultoria para entrega das obrigações, mediante a execução de controles internos, e a realização de testes para comprovação de evidências;

4. Assegurar a correta emissão das Guias de pagamentos dos Tributos nas esferas Federais, Estaduais e Municipais, analisando as contas razões do Passivo, as notas fiscais de serviços para o recolhimento do ISS, avaliando que tipo de serviço foi prestado e para qual Prefeitura o imposto é devido;

5. Apoiar nos projetos de revisão fiscal, atendendo o consultor externo, levantando documentação;

6. Entregar ECF, levantando documentação, realizando conferencia de documentos;

7. Contribuir junto a Consultoria para automatização e melhoria de processos no SAP, participando com os consultores no planejamento e coletando informações junto à demais áreas envolvidas;

8. Apuração de impostos no fechamento de cambio, levantando informações e conferindo documentos para apuração dos impostos devidos nas remessas para o exterior;

You will be joining a growing, dynamic team, and in this role as an Engagement Leader, you will expand and deepen your consulting skills by leading various projects as well as managing junior team members. The main purpose of the Consultant is to develop consulting solutions as part of client engagements, to write proposals and support business development activities, to act as engagement manager on specific projects and to support Principals and Partners in their delivery.

You will begin to lead, manage, and own problem-solving efforts on a large portion of a client engagement or to lead on smaller engagements. Throughout an engagement, you will be involved in discussions and presentations with senior client leadership.

  • Building and maintaining relationships with colleagues across Heidrick & Struggles in Brazil and globally.

  • Involving yourself in internal initiatives, supporting ongoing improvements of business and employee experience; many initiatives are global and will provide an opportunity to build a global network.

Self-Driven and Inquisitive: Exhibits a strong desire to continuously learn and explore new topics relevant to client organizations and industry sectors.

Entrepreneurial Spirit and Team Player: Possesses an entrepreneurial mindset with a keen interest in contributing to a growing business unit. Brings innovative ideas and a proactive approach to delivering on agreed deadlines and client deliverables.

title: Profissional Backend .Net
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

  • Experiência Sólida em Back-end .NET para Ambientes Escaláveis
  • Atuação comprovada em sistemas de alta volumetria (milhões de requisições diárias/mensais).
  • Domínio em arquitetura de microsserviços .
  • Vivência prática com AWS (EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3) .
  • Experiência com CI/CD , versionamento utilizando Git.
  • Desejável certificações AWS e/ou conhecimentos em Azure ou GCP .
  • Sólido conhecimento em RabbitMQ ou tecnologias similares (Kafka).
  • Desenvolvimento de soluções com fluxos assíncronos e escaláveis.
  • Forte atuação com SQL Server e MySQL .
  • Experiência com MongoDB ou outros bancos NoSQL .
  • Compromisso com boas práticas de segurança, performance e resiliência.

Diferencial: experiência com containers (Docker, Kubernetes) e sistemas altamente disponíveis.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

Estamos presentes em mais de 4.800 municípios, somando mais de 83 milhões de clientes. Lideramos o saldo de portabilidade há mais de 5 anos.

Sustentabilidade é um valor para a Claro. Investimos no desenvolvimento ambiental, economico e social, prezando sempre pela governança, responsabilidade ambiental, proteção de dados e impacto social. Por meio do Instituto Claro , conectamos pessoas para um futuro melhor, aliando os serviços prestados a investimentos sociais em projetos de educação e cidadania.

E aí, deu match? Vem pra Claro construir o novo com a gente!

Como será o seu dia a dia?

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Kit office.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença em mais de 892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 24.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Assim como profissionais pertencentes à todas as identidades e expressões de gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência visível e/ou invisível e origens étnico-raciais. Nossa equipe de R&S está pessoalmente à disposição para avaliar candidaturas das pessoas com deficiência para quaisquer outras vagas no Grupo Cobra Brasil.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Conduzir processos de recrutamento e seleção de ponta a ponta (análise de vagas, anúncio, triagem, entrevistas, avaliação, seleção e integração).

  • Clima organizacional e engajamento: aplicação de pesquisas de satisfação, elaboração de ações para melhoria do ambiente de trabalho.
  • Remuneração e cargos: auxiliar na estruturação de cargos e salários, pesquisa de mercado, alinhamento com a política interna.
  • Desenvolvimento organizacional: apoiar programas de melhoria de processos, mudanças organizacionais e cultura.
  • Melhoria de processos de RH: mapear processos, propor e implementar melhorias com foco em eficiência e conformidade.

QUALIFICAÇÃO:

Informamos que nossas vagas são divulgadas somente pela equipe de Gente e Gestão e não possuem qualquer tipo de custo para os candidatos interessados. Qualquer recebimento inadequado ou cobrança, pedimos que entre com contato com o nosso Canal de Conformidade através do telefone .

  • Sólida vivência em operações “rigless” e intervenções com e sem sonda.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:

  • Strong with IaC (Terraform/Pulumi) and CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions)

  • Proficiency in Python for automation
  • Solid networking/security fundamentals

At Findly, engineers own what they build—from prototype to production.

title: Souring Specialist

  • Build and maintain long-term partnerships with both local and international suppliers.

  • Proven track record in sourcing, procurement, or buying within fashion, beauty, or cosmetics.
  • Strong supplier network and market knowledge in Brazil and LATAM.
  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in English (Portuguese and/or Spanish strongly preferred).
  • Highly analytical with the ability to balance creativity and commercial thinking.
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced, global environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Fashion Management, or a related field.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work with a leading international organization with global reach.
  • A collaborative and innovative culture where your ideas truly matter.
  • Career growth in an exciting and evolving industry.
  • Competitive package with the chance to directly influence business success.

title: Gerente Regional de RH | RJ | ES | MG
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.

O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar os subsistemas de RH: recrutamento e seleção, treinamento e desenvolvimento, remuneração e benefícios, relações trabalhistas, comunicação interna e gestão de desempenho.
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das lideranças, oferecendo suporte em temas relacionados à gestão de pessoas.
  • Conduzir processos de mudança organizacional, programas de engajamento e ações de clima organizacional.
  • Atuar como guardião das políticas e procedimentos da Companhia, assegurando sua aplicação e atualização contínua.
  • Garantir conformidade com a legislação trabalhista e normas internas.
  • Gerenciar indicadores de RH e elaborar relatórios gerenciais para suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Supervisionar a equipe de RH, promovendo o desenvolvimento contínuo e a capacitação do time.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de transformação digital e metodologias ágeis aplicadas à gestão de pessoas.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de análise e gestão de dados (como SAP, Power BI e pacote Office) para suporte às atividades da área.
  • Atuação com Centro de Distribuição.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Psicologia, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Pessoas, Administração ou áreas afins.

title: CHAIR of CEO Advisory Board Group
description:
Chair - Vistage

A Vistage, com mais de 40.000 membros, é a organização líder mundial para CEOs e proprietários de negócios. Além de sua escala, a Vistage é uma comunidade onde líderes empresariais experientes e apaixonados podem compartilhar conhecimentos e casos reais para ajudar uns aos outros a crescer e alcançar objetivos pessoais e profissionais.

Há mais de 20 anos, a Vistage tem ajudado membros no Brasil a tomar melhores decisões com sua metodologia altamente eficaz e proprietária.

Visão Geral da Função:

O Chair da Vistage é uma posição estratégica que combina os papéis de facilitador, mentor e coach para nossos membros. O Chair é fundamental na implementação de nossa metodologia e na condução das experiências transformadoras dentro de nossa comunidade.

Como Chair da Vistage, você liderará grupos de líderes empresariais de diversos setores que compartilham desafios comuns. Seja como proprietários de seus negócios ou CEOs de empresas nacionais e internacionais, todos os membros estão unidos por um objetivo comum: buscar aconselhamento e orientação de seus pares para superar o isolamento típico de um número um.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar e facilitar reuniões de grupo de líderes empresariais.
  • Proporcionar mentoria e coaching individual aos membros.
  • Implementar e manter a metodologia proprietária da Vistage.
  • Fomentar um ambiente colaborativo e de apoio para que os membros compartilhem conhecimentos e experiências.
  • Promover o engajamento e a retenção dos membros através de liderança eficaz e gestão de relacionamentos.
  • Construir e iniciar um grupo de, no mínimo, 8 membros e expandi-lo para 16 membros nos meses seguintes.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia como alto executivo: Experiência como CEO, C-level, Managing Director, Diretor Geral ou cargos similares.
  • Disponibilidade para dedicar tempo na formação do grupo e depois de formado, ter de 10 a 15 dias por mês para dedicar às reuniões (em grupo e individuais).
  • Extensa rede de contatos e relacionamentos.
  • Fortes habilidades de vendas e prospecção.
  • Capacidade financeira para gerenciar a fase inicial.
  • Capacidade de liderança e gestão de pessoas.
  • CNPJ aberto para contrato B2B.

Remuneração:

Mensal e variável. Os ganhos são diretamente proporcionais ao número de grupos/membros coordenados e ao tempo dedicado à função.

Modelo de Atuação:

O Chair atua como um profissional autônomo com liberdade para gerenciar sua agenda de acordo com as necessidades dos membros.

Reunião de grupo mensal obrigatória - presencial.

Reuniões individuais mensais com cada membro - online ou presencial (flexível).

Depoimento de um Chair:

"O que mais me gratifica na minha função de Chair é saber que ajudei os meus membros a crescerem, não somente dentro de suas companhias, mas também como pessoas."

Se você é um ex-executivo de alto nível buscando consolidar sua carreira como conselheiro ou consultor e deseja causar um impacto significativo nos líderes empresariais, candidate-se agora para se juntar à Vistage e liderar um grupo de profissionais de alto nível em sua jornada para o sucesso!

title: Scheduling Optimization Engineer
description:
Job Description
About You
You are a data-driven professional passionate about solving complex scheduling and resource allocation challenges. You thrive on applying advanced optimization techniques to real-world problems, balancing mathematical rigor with practical feasibility. With strong analytical and modeling skills, you design solutions that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and ensure compliance with operational and regulatory requirements.
You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:
  • Advanced knowledge of optimization modeling (integer programming, constraint programming, heuristics/metaheuristics).
  • Proven experience developing and maintaining large-scale scheduling models in applied environments.
  • Ability to incorporate operational rules, contractual agreements, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Hands-on experience with optimization solvers (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools).
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Julia, or C++.
  • Strong understanding of data analysis for planning based on event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destination planning.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You will be accountable for the following responsabilities:
Develop and maintain advanced optimization models to solve large-scale scheduling problems.
Build models that consider event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destinations using available data.
Integrate operational rules, contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
Apply optimization solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools) to generate feasible, efficient schedules.
Collaborate with operations, planning, and technology teams to align outputs with real-world needs.
Analyze results to identify cost savings, efficiency improvements, and compliance risks.
Continuously refine models to adapt to changes in resource availability, demand patterns, and operational constraints.

title: Principal Installation Analysis Engineer 25003289
description:
Job Overview:

The Principal Installation Analysis Engineer is responsible for interpreting internal or external business issues and recommending best practices. They will be tasked with solving complex Installation Analysis-related problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal Installation Analysis Engineer may be responsible for leading functional teams or projects and is regarded as a specialist in Installation Analysis. As such, they must have in-depth expertise in Installation Analysis as well as broad knowledge of the Installation Analysis discipline within the Engineering function.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Perform conceptual, FEED, and detailed analyses and design as per design basis, project specifications, design codes, and standards
  • Apply in-depth skills and broad knowledge of the business to address complex problems and nonstandard situations
  • Prepare clear and accurate detailed design calculations and analyses including design reports and - procedures
  • Manage own time to meet objectives and (as Lead Engineer) forecast and plan resource requirements
  • Communicate and explain difficult concepts and persuade others to adopt a point of view
  • When acting as Lead Engineer, in addition:
  • Direct an Engineering team as a Lead Engineer
  • Lead the Discipline engineering design of the assigned work area and complete it within the planned schedule and budget, in accordance with standards, MDR, and project-specific procedures and to a high professional standard
  • Plan, organize, and direct all aspects of Discipline execution on the assigned project including scope, deliverables, schedule, and all manpower resources - agree allocations with the Discipline Manager
  • Ensure interfaces and deliverables are clearly identified
  • Maintain responsibility for progress and productivity, identifying any required corrective action
  • Act as project representative for Discipline during meetings with the Project Team, Customer discipline lead, and relevant agencies such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc.
  • Become fully familiar with the project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and all inter-discipline requirements; including identifying concerns as early as practicable and taking appropriate initiatives to address issues, interpreting contractual requirements as they relate to engineering execution
  • Identify changes to scope and promptly raise change notifications, including providing any necessary supporting documentation and estimates Provide similar support for variation orders
  • Interface with all disciplines to develop clash-free designs
  • Interface with other departments to obtain input for discipline designs and drawings
  • Maintain close coordination with other engineering disciplines, Planning, fabrication, Marine, and Project Management Teams, as required
  • Document substantive communications (communications that result in significant decisions or assignment of actions) and forward copies to Discipline Lead Engineer and Discipline Manager
  • Prepare estimates for bid proposals, including technical query reviews, execution statements, and manhour estimates, identifying software requirements and any other project-specific requirements
  • Raise technical queries to obtain missing information, clarify work scope, and maintain preferred McDermott procedures, specifications, standards, practices, and operational requirements
  • Prepare, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve engineering design basis, philosophies, and technical specifications
  • Participate in finalizing deliverable lists and deliverables, ensuring compliance with specifications and functional integrity
  • Review project schedule and fabrication schedule in relation to construction sequence, milestones, and engineering scope
  • Attend project kickoff and review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys, as required
  • Provide technical direction and review of Designers producing products related to Installation Support Engineering
  • Prepare, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve design reports and procedures
  • Assist in providing necessary design inputs to other disciplines to enable them to proceed with their deliverables
  • Assist procurement personnel in procuring discipline equipment, materials, and services; ensuring that work produced complies with Customer objectives and procedures Procurement assistance includes preparing, reviewing, and (as Lead Engineer) approving requisitions, evaluating technical quotations, and preparing queries, compiling bid tabulations and recommendations, preparing purchase requisitions, and coordinating with Procurement to expedite vendor documents, as directed by Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in updating weight report based on receipt of vendor information
  • Review and (as Lead Engineer) approve vendor and subcontractor submittals, checking for compliance with project specifications and providing comments as necessary
  • Review and (as Lead Engineer) approve design verification through single-discipline check /inter-discipline check (IDC)
  • Provide technical support to all fabrication queries, including identifying defect/rectification requirements
  • Keep the Discipline Manager and Project Management Team apprised of all activities and concerns, technical, budgetary and manpower related
  • Assist in providing inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports including associated productivity
  • Check final subcontractor and vendor data manuals to ensure that all requested data has been received and approved
  • Present issues and problems to Customers in a timely manner and assist the Lead Engineer in negotiating resolution in accordance with project and company requirements
  • Perform (as required) Technical Quality Audit reviews in accordance with MDR Global Procedures
  • Assist Lead engineer with responses to Customers and other agencies (such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc.) on their review and approval
  • Capture lessons learned and enter into MDR’s Lessons Learned system
  • Guide less experienced engineers on MDR and Discipline procedures, standards, worksheets, auditors, third parties, etc.) on their review and approval
  • Supervise and guide assigned engineers and coordinate with Lead Designers for Discipline engineering and design deliverables
  • Responsible for the engineering integrity of the assigned work area
  • Monitor costs of own work processes
  • Assist in the maintenance of departmental technical guidelines and standard calculation notes
  • Participate in development and maintenance of Global Procedures, Software, and Standards
  • May participate in standards development committees or task groups such as API
  • Develop communication and presentation skills (e.g., write technical papers, participate in conferences and/or seminars, present design solutions, and/or present topics at ‘lunch and learn’; etc.)
  • Identify and provide training to staff in specific techniques and proprietary software
  • Provide information on employee performance to the Discipline Manager
  • Assist the Discipline manager in interviewing job applicants
  • Perform, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve Pipeline Installation engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for loadout, transportation, and installation (including installation aids):
  • Submarine pipelines
  • Risers
  • Spools
  • PLETS and manifolds
  • Cables
  • Perform, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve Structural Installation engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for loadout, transportation, and installation (including installation aids) of offshore structures, including barge upgrades/modifications
  • When acting as Lead engineer, in addition:
  • Act as project-based discipline point of contact in communications and meetings with customer counterparts
  • Ensure substantive communications are documented
  • Prepare bids and projects discipline engineering budget and execution plans
  • Identify project staff needs based on knowledge of individual engineer’s skill sets and provide requests to the discipline manager
  • Plan, organize, and assign tasks, responsibilities, and manhour budgets to the discipline team, and verify tasks are completed within budgets
  • Plan discipline deliverable schedule/register compliant with the overall execution plan
  • Prepare work forecasts identifying change management plans, corrective action, and real-time schedule
  • Provide discipline inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports including associated productivity

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Naval Architecture, Civil/Structural/Mechanical Engineering (Master’s is a preference)
  • 15-20 years of experience in oil and gas with a major contractor or consultant predominantly performing construction and installation design
  • Detailed knowledge of design techniques and analysis methods, and detailed knowledge of the theory, content, and application of standards, codes, and guidelines as applicable Knowledgeable in project coordination and execution skills
  • Preferably Registered Professional Engineer or member of a professional engineering society

description:

Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Projetos com perfil estratégico, criativo e executor , capaz de liderar um time multidisciplinar (estrategistas, roteiristas, social medias, editores, designers, desenvolvedores e outros) e garantir a entrega de resultados concretos para nossos clientes e para os perfis da própria empresa.

  • Estabelecer e acompanhar KPIs e OKRs de views, seguidores, engajamento, compartilhamentos, comentários e geração de leads.

  • Garantir alinhamento com clientes e stakeholders, transformando expectativas em resultados palpáveis .
  • Resolver gargalos rápido, sem desculpas – sempre com foco no plano e no resultado .

  • Autoresponsável : faz o que precisa ser feito para atingir os objetivos.
  • Criativo e flexível : encontra soluções inteligentes em cenários de comunicação e tecnologia.
  • Líder de verdade : sabe cobrar, apoiar e treinar o time para elevar o nível da entrega.
  • Focado em resultado e retenção : entende que manter o cliente satisfeito é tão importante quanto bater as metas.
  • Faminto por oportunidade : alguém que QUER MUITO esse trabalho e está disposto a dar o máximo.
O que você precisa ter
  • Experiência prévia em gestão de projetos .
  • Capacidade comprovada de trabalhar com metas de performance .
  • Excelente organização, visão estratégica e disciplina em gestão de processos.
  • Habilidade de comunicação e negociação para reduzir churn, reter clientes e elevar a satisfação .
Nossos valores
  1. Ser gente boa
  2. Entregar mais do que o esperado
  3. Sem desculpas, siga o plano
  4. Honestidade a qualquer preço
  5. Foco no resultado
O que oferecemos
  • Salário competitivo.
  • Ambiente de crescimento acelerado e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Oportunidade de liderar projetos que impactam milhares de pessoas todos os dias.
  • Resumo: Esta vaga é para quem quer liderar times criativos e técnicos , unir estratégia de conteúdo com construção de plataformas, garantir resultados, reter clientes a qualquer custo e formar equipes de alta performance com as contratações certas .

title: Analista Júnior - Modelagem Econômico-Financeira

title: MECÂNICO
description:
Descrição

O Mecânico de Manutenção de Equipamentos Pesados será um profissional chave na equipe, responsável por assegurar a plena operacionalidade e segurança de uma vasta gama de máquinas. Este profissional irá realizar diagnósticos e reparos em sistemas elétricos, de refrigeração e mecânica hidráulica, atuando na manutenção preventiva e corretiva de Guindastes LIEBHERR e FUWA, Empilhadeiras HYUNDAI e HYSTER, e equipamentos da Linha Amarela, incluindo máquinas Volvo e Caterpillar. Será essencial a leitura e interpretação de diagramas para identificação e resolução de falhas, assim como a substituição precisa de peças e componentes. O(a) Mecânico(a) deverá assegurar a conformidade das manutenções com as normas de segurança (como NBR 15965), gerenciar e priorizar tarefas sob prazos, lidar dinamicamente com múltiplas demandas, aplicar senso crítico e de urgência na resolução de problemas, e manter atenção rigorosa aos detalhes em todas as etapas, além de preencher relatórios de serviço e registros de manutenção de forma precisa e organizada.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

– Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva de máquinas e equipamentos.
– Diagnosticar falhas e defeitos mecânicos em sistemas diversos.
– Fazer ajustes e regulagens em componentes mecânicos.
– Monitorar o funcionamento de máquinas, identificando a necessidade de reparos.
– Elaborar relatórios sobre as atividades de manutenção realizadas.
– Colaborar na montagem e desmonte de equipamentos, conforme necessário.
– Cumprir normas de segurança e procedimentos operacionais estabelecidos.
– Acompanhar a manutenção de registros e documentação técnica.

Requisitos e qualificações

Amplo conhecimento em elétrica para manutenção de equipamentos.Conhecimento sólido em sistemas de refrigeração.Conhecimento Mecânico Hidráulico.Leitura de Diagrama e identificação de falhas.Conhecimento em Empilhadeiras e Guindastes (incluindo modelos LIEBHERR, FUWA, HYUNDAI, HYSTER).Conhecimento e experiência em manutenção de equipamentos da Linha Amarela (Volvo e Caterpillar).Conhecimento da norma NBR 15965 (se relevante para o escopo da empresa).

Habilidade em Vendas: Experiência com vendas internas (Inside Sales), especialmente em áreas consultivas como estética, saúde ou bem-estar.

Excelência na Comunicação: Saber escutar, compreender e se comunicar de forma clara e persuasiva, tanto por telefone quanto por mensagens.
